title: S127 17.1.3 Matching Responses to Client Transactions
parent_path: S127 17.1.3 Matching Responses to Client Transactions

statements.subject: transaction
statements.description: A response matches a client transaction if the response has the same value of the branch parameter in the top Via header field as the branch parameter in the top Via header field of the request that created the transaction.

statements.subject: transaction
statements.description: A response matches a client transaction if the method parameter in the CSeq header field matches the method of the request that created the transaction.

statements.subject: transaction
statements.description: If a request is sent via multicast, multiple responses may arrive with the same branch parameter. The first response received will be used, and others will be viewed as retransmissions.
statements.pre_cond: transport.multicast = true & transaction.response_received = true & response.top_via.branch = transaction.request.top_via.branch
